name: Change of Scene
author: bli
description: Time the pink pad and then skip the blue orb at 42.7% to fall to the floor as the spider. Click once at 43.1% when you cannot see your icon and then click again at 43.2% to be able to see your icon. Buffer a jump after the pink pads at 44.1% to move back to the floor. Click to move to the ceiling between the decoration and hitboxes at 44.7% and stay there. Click to move back to the floor shortly after your icon passes the 4x speed ship portal once the percentage bar is past 100%. Soon after you will enter a cube portal on the floor. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
